post.title: Just finished reading Anxiety by Samir Chopra
post.description: The book felt like it was written for me. I learned so much from it, got so much to think about, so much to shed, so much to unpack. I feel resolved to live a more authentic life,
post.fileName: now Just finished reading Anxiety by Samir Chopra.md
post.html: The book felt like it was written for me. I learned so much from it, got so much to think about, so much to shed, so much to unpack. I feel resolved to live a more authentic life, to take anxiety as a sign of disintegrated self, and to believe "self" to be somewhere between self and no-self.

nowPosts.title: Feeling amazed by this video
nowPosts.description: I really like Design Theory channels opinions and reflections.
nowPosts.html: This video talks about how minimalism, simplicity in design, and now AI, are all driving us towards mediocrity. Intentionality is going to make us distinct from slop farms, we FEEL there we are! It was really tongue in the cheek to sees how Cyberpunk 2077 has better designs than whatever current car industry is coming up with.

nowPosts.title: Feeling pissed at the world
nowPosts.html: I recently poured my ongoing angst about the world in this blog post, Maybe you relate? Maybe you vehemently disagree? It covers content from two of my drafts in one, so that's two less problems in my life.
